title: eludite.debug.snapshot input
description: Where the debuggee is and why: read this first at every break, before stepping or evaluating. It answers the stop summary (debug-stop-summary.output.json) in one call: the stop reason and location, the exception or breakpoint behind it, the top frames, the frame's locals expanded to `depth`, the watches, the program's output since `output_since`, the adapter's `capabilities` and whether an agent is driving. It is sized for a model's context (by default 10 frames, 50 variables, 200 characters per value, 20 output lines; every list says `total` and `truncated`), runs no debuggee code and costs a few adapter round trips. Pass `thread` and `frame` to look at another frame without moving the windows' selection. While the program runs it answers `mode` `running` and the latest output, so it is a cheap poll; in any other mode it is refused. Next: eludite.debug.variables to page or expand a value, eludite.debug.stack for deeper frames, eludite.debug.exception_info at an exception, or a resuming command (continue, step_over, step_into, step_out, run_to_cursor) quoting `stop`.

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: the active session, the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and the execution point follows. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.

thread.description: A thread id (from `threads` in eludite.debug.state). Default: the thread that stopped.

frame.description: Index in that thread's call stack (0 is the top). Default: 0. Reading another frame never moves the windows' selection (eludite.debug.select_frame does).

depth.description: How many levels of the locals to expand: 1 (default) lists the top level only; up to 5. Expansion is breadth-first and stops when `max_variables` rows are listed.

max_variables.description: The most variable rows listed, counting every level (default 50, at most 500).

max_value_chars.description: Values longer than this are cut and end with `… (N chars)`, the row saying `value_truncated` (default 200, at most 10000).

max_frames.description: The most stack frames listed (default 10, at most 200); page further with eludite.debug.stack.

max_output_lines.description: The most program output lines listed (default 20, at most 1000; 0 lists none).

output_since.description: An output cursor (`output.next` of an earlier answer, or eludite.debug.output's `next`): list the program's lines from it on. Default: the last `max_output_lines` lines.
